claims.label: AVOIDABLE_REDUNDANCY

dom_evidence.value: This stylish and comfortable padded bed... Featuring an easy-to-clean PU leather finish

claims.reason: The DOM already identifies the bed as black and padded/upholstered with PU/faux leather. The claim adds no necessary semantic detail.

dom_evidence.value: This bed features a unique curved design that adds a modern touch to the bedroom.

claims.claim: Wide headboard that curves around the sides
claims.label: UNAVOIDABLE_REPETITION

dom_evidence.value: This bed features a unique curved design that adds a modern touch to the bedroom. The well-designed headboard provides great support so you can lean back comfortably.
The unique ergonomic design of the curved bed adds infinite comfort to your nighttime reading or movie moments.

claims.reason: The DOM already establishes both a curved design and a headboard. Repeating those concepts is needed to anchor the new structural detail that the headboard is wide and wraps around the sides.

claims.claim: Cyan LED strip following the front and right-side edges of the base and rising beside the headboard
claims.label: UNAVOIDABLE_REPETITION

dom_evidence.value: The bed is surrounded by LED lights, controlled by a 24-key remote control. You can adjust the color and brightness according to your mood.

claims.reason: The DOM establishes that the bed has adjustable surrounding LED lighting. Referring to the LED strip is necessary to convey the new visual details of its cyan color and its specific route around the base and beside the headboard.
